gates.scope: datagates re-run on this view (G31); the whole ledger: 85 error and 790 warning findings, every error-named record withheld (below)

rules.privacy: left out: living_possible flag without a recorded death, or no death and the latest possible birth within 110 years of 2026-10-29; unions touching them are left out
rules.withheld: left out: every record an error finding names (pipeline gates G04/G06/G09/G21/G23, datagates D00-D15 through the FamilyMember adapter), then datagates re-run on the view until no error is left
rules.house: core member: own house label (curated/houses.json maps the source labels; precedence picks the first label that names a house), except that a core wife of a core husband takes his house (as an adult she belonged to it); in-law: house of the spouse at marriage (earliest dated union with a core partner), else own label; anyone else in a union: a partner's house; anyone else: a parent's house (father first)
rules.core: a source flag (any partition saying core) where one exists, else descent from a dye founder
rules.family: the source family field (in-law:X gives X; unverified gives null), else the father's, else a dye-carrying mother's
rules.shares: exact expected fraction of descent from each dye's founders over the people in this view: founder 1, child = mean of parents, an unknown or left-out parent counts 0 (a lower bound)
rules.generation: [min, max] parent-to-child steps from any dye founder over all descent paths; others aligned to a partner, else one above their children, else one below their parents; null when unplaced
rules.phi: kinship.py (Karigl recursion, exact) over the parents in this view; close = phi > 0; relationship from kinship.explain, avuncular named as in the contract
rules.confidence: Confirmed only when two independent source families (fact-check, harvest), each at least Likely, agree on birth, death and parents and none contradicts; otherwise the best single-source grade (at most Likely); parents contested between such families give Suspected
rules.father_mother: a parent's stated sex decides; else the role a source gives (harvest father/mother; fact-check order, father first, checked by G29); else a gendered title in the name or a note saying son or daughter of; otherwise the parent is not placed (null), never guessed, and every derived value is computed over the published links only
rules.years: the accepted date's first year; precision is the source's (day, month, year, circa, uncertain); compatible dates from different sources agree, the most precise stands
rules.events: only harvest events with one cited secondary source (grade L) that name no one the view leaves out

people.name: Mayer Amschel Rothschild
people.note: Founder of M. A. Rothschild & Söhne in Frankfurt; father of the five brothers who founded the Frankfurt, Vienna, London, Naples and Paris houses. Born 23 February 1743 or 1744 (sources differ); died 19 September 1812.

people.name: Gutle Schnapper (Gutle Rothschild)
people.note: Married Mayer Amschel on 29 August 1770; mother of ten surviving children including the five founding brothers. (No English Wikipedia article: the source link was dead.)

people.name: Schönche Jeannette Rothschild
people.note: Eldest child of Mayer Amschel Rothschild; married the Frankfurt merchant Benedikt Moses Worms on 28 January 1795; six children, three of them sons, who were later ennobled.

people.name: Benedikt Moses Worms
people.note: Frankfurt merchant; married Jeannette Rothschild, eldest daughter of Mayer Amschel Rothschild, on 28 January 1795.

people.name: Amschel Mayer von Rothschild
people.note: Eldest son; head of the Frankfurt house. Married Eva Hanau in 1796 and died childless (6 December 1855), after which nephews Mayer Carl and Wilhelm Carl ran the Frankfurt bank.

people.name: Salomon Mayer von Rothschild
people.note: Founded the Vienna house; his bank financed the Nordbahn, Austria's first steam railway (claim tagged citation-needed on Wikipedia). Lost influence after Metternich's fall in 1848, handed the bank to his son Anselm and retired to Paris…

people.name: Nathan Mayer Rothschild
people.note: Founded the London house (N M Rothschild & Sons). From 1811, working with Commissary-General J. C. Herries, he arranged the transfer of money to pay Wellington's troops in the Peninsula. Died in Frankfurt on 28 July 1836 after travelling…

people.name: Eva Hanau
people.note: Wife of Amschel Mayer (m. 1796); the couple had no children.

people.name: Bernhard Juda Sichel
people.note: Frankfurt businessman; married Isabella Rothschild in 1802.

people.name: Isabella Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Mayer Amschel Rothschild; married the Frankfurt businessman Bernhard Juda Sichel in 1802.

people.name: Caroline Stern
people.note: Wife of Salomon (m. 1800); mother of Anselm and Betty.

people.name: Hannah Barent Cohen
people.note: Married Nathan in London on 22 October 1806; mother of seven children who carried the London house's cousin marriages. (No English Wikipedia article: the source link was dead.)

people.name: Babette Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Mayer Amschel Rothschild; married Siegmund Leopold Beyfus in 1808.

people.name: Siegmund Leopold Beyfus
people.note: Married Babette Rothschild, daughter of Mayer Amschel Rothschild, in 1808.

people.name: Abraham Montefiore
people.note: Married Henriette Rothschild, youngest daughter of Mayer Amschel Rothschild, in 1815.

people.name: Carl Mayer von Rothschild
people.note: Sent from Frankfurt to Naples in 1821, where he founded the Naples house; died in Naples on 10 March 1855. (It was his sons Mayer Carl and Wilhelm Carl, not Carl, who took over Frankfurt.)

people.name: Julie Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Mayer Amschel Rothschild; married Mayer Levin Beyfus in 1811 and died in 1815.

people.name: Mayer Levin Beyfus
people.note: Married Julie Rothschild, daughter of Mayer Amschel Rothschild, in 1811; she died in 1815.

people.name: Henriette (Jette) Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Mayer Amschel; married the London merchant Abraham Montefiore (1788–1824) in 1815. Mother of Louisa, who married her cousin Anthony de Rothschild.

people.name: James Mayer de Rothschild
people.note: Founded the Paris house (de Rothschild Frères); a major financier of French railways and mining. Married his niece Betty, daughter of his brother Salomon, on 11 July 1824.

people.name: Adelheid Herz
people.note: Wife of Carl (m. 16 September 1818); mother of Charlotte, Mayer Carl, Adolph Carl and Wilhelm Carl.

people.name: Anselm Salomon von Rothschild
people.note: Head of the Vienna house after Salomon; founded the Creditanstalt in 1855, which became the largest bank of Austria-Hungary. Married his first cousin Charlotte, daughter of Nathan, in 1826.

people.name: Betty von Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Salomon; married her uncle James in 1824. Noted for her Paris salon (Heine, Balzac, Rossini) and her patronage of the arts; Ingres painted her portrait (1841–48).

people.name: Charlotte Nathan Rothschild
people.note: Eldest child of Nathan; married her first cousin Anselm of Vienna in 1826; mother of Julie, Mathilde, Ferdinand, Albert Salomon and Alice.

people.name: Lionel de Rothschild
people.note: Head of N M Rothschild & Sons. Elected MP for the City of London in 1847 but able to take his seat only on 26 July 1858, as the first Jewish member of Parliament. Married his first cousin Charlotte, daughter of Carl, in 1836.

people.name: Sir Anthony de Rothschild, 1st Baronet
people.note: Created a baronet in 1847. Married (1840) his first cousin Louisa Montefiore, daughter of his aunt Henriette Rothschild.

people.name: Nathaniel de Rothschild
people.note: London-born fourth child of Nathan who settled in Paris; in 1853 bought Château Brane-Mouton in Pauillac and renamed it (Mouton Rothschild). Married his first cousin Charlotte, daughter of James, in 1842.

people.name: Hannah Mayer Rothschild
people.note: Married the Hon. Henry FitzRoy (1807–1859), a non-Jew, in 1839.

people.name: Mayer Amschel de Rothschild
people.note: Youngest son of Nathan; built Mentmore Towers. Married Juliana Cohen (1850); father of Hannah, Countess of Rosebery.

people.name: Charlotte von Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Carl; married her first cousin Lionel on 15 June 1836. A leading London hostess and philanthropist with a special interest in education, who guided the couple's art collecting. (She was not an 'artist and pianist': that…

people.name: Louise de Rothschild (Luise von Rothschild)
people.note: Youngest child of Nathan; married her first cousin Mayer Carl of the Naples line on 6 April 1842 in London; mother of seven daughters, three of whom married Rothschild cousins.

people.name: Mayer Carl von Rothschild
people.note: With his brother Wilhelm Carl, head of the Frankfurt house after their uncle Amschel's death (1855); member of the Reichstag; in 1871 the first Jewish member of the Prussian House of Lords. Seven daughters, three of whom married…

people.name: Louisa de Rothschild (née Montefiore)
people.note: Daughter of Henriette Rothschild and Abraham Montefiore; married her first cousin Anthony in 1840; mother of Constance (Lady Battersea) and Annie Yorke.

people.name: Adolph Carl von Rothschild
people.note: Ran the Naples house; sided with the deposed Bourbon king Francis II after Garibaldi took Naples (1860), and the house closed in 1863. Married his cousin Julie, daughter of Anselm, in 1850; childless. Left his Pregny château and…

people.name: Charlotte de Rothschild
people.note: Only daughter of James and Betty; married her first cousin Nathaniel in 1842. A painter who exhibited at the Paris Salon (1872), and Chopin's piano pupil from 1841.

people.name: Alphonse James de Rothschild
people.note: Head of de Rothschild Frères; regent of the Banque de France from 1855. His bank played a major role in raising the five-billion-franc indemnity after the Franco-Prussian War. Married Leonora, daughter of his first cousin Lionel, in 1857.

people.name: Wilhelm Carl von Rothschild
people.note: Last head of M. A. Rothschild & Söhne: with no male heir in the Frankfurt line, the house was wound up at his death in 1901. Married his cousin Hannah Mathilde, daughter of Anselm, in 1849.

people.name: Gustave Samuel James de Rothschild
people.note: Partner in de Rothschild Frères; married Cécile Anspach (1859), outside the family. Father of Robert.

people.name: Caroline Julie von Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Anselm; married her cousin Adolph Carl in 1850; childless.

people.name: Hannah Mathilde von Rothschild
people.note: Song composer (studied with Chopin; published a volume of 30 mélodies in 1878). Married her father's cousin Wilhelm Carl in 1849.

people.name: Salomon James de Rothschild
people.note: Married his cousin Adèle, daughter of Mayer Carl, in 1862 and died two years later aged 29; father of Hélène van Zuylen.

people.name: Nathaniel Meyer von Rothschild
people.note: Son of Anselm Salomon; the Austria page credits a Nathaniel Anselm von Rothschild with founding psychiatric institutions in 1898.

people.name: Leonora de Rothschild
people.note: Eldest child of Lionel; married Alphonse of the Paris house (her father's first cousin) in 1857.

people.name: Evelina de Rothschild
people.note: Married her cousin Ferdinand in 1865 and died on 4 December 1866 after the stillbirth of their son; the Evelina Hospital is named after her.

people.name: Ferdinand de Rothschild
people.note: Vienna-line son of Anselm who settled in England. Built Waddesdon Manor (1874–89) and left it to his sister Alice; bequeathed his Renaissance treasury (the Waddesdon Bequest) to the British Museum. Founded the Evelina Hospital in memory…

people.name: Cecile Anspach
people.note: Wife of Gustave de Rothschild, married in 1859.

people.name: Nathan Mayer 'Natty' Rothschild, 1st Baron Rothschild
people.note: Head of N M Rothschild & Sons; created Baron Rothschild in 1885, the first Jewish member of the House of Lords not to have converted to Christianity. Married his double first cousin Emma Louise in 1867.

people.name: Alfred Charles de Rothschild
people.note: Director of the Bank of England 1868–1889, its first Jewish director; never married.

people.name: Adèle Hannah Charlotte von Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Mayer Carl; married Salomon James in 1862; mother of Hélène van Zuylen.

people.name: Maximilian von Goldschmidt-Rothschild
people.note: Banker; married Minna Caroline von Rothschild in 1878. The couple added the Rothschild name to their own, and he was created Baron von Goldschmidt-Rothschild.

people.name: Albert Salomon von Rothschild
people.note: Head of the Vienna house; married Bettina, daughter of Alphonse, in 1876.

people.name: Emma Louise von Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Mayer Carl; married her double first cousin Natty in 1867; mother of Walter and Charles.

people.name: Nathan James Édouard de Rothschild
people.note: Son of Nathaniel (Mouton) and Charlotte; married his cousin Laura Thérèse, daughter of Mayer Carl, in 1871; father of Henri. (The source files wrongly make him a son of Alphonse; one file gives him James Armand's dates.)

people.name: Edmond James de Rothschild
people.note: Youngest child of James; patron of the First Aliyah settlements, called 'the Father of the Yishuv' and 'HaNadiv HaYadua' (the Known Benefactor); founded PICA in 1924. Married his cousin Adelheid, daughter of Wilhelm Carl, in 1877.

people.name: Leopold de Rothschild
people.note: Married Marie Perugia (1881), outside the family; father of Lionel Nathan and Anthony Gustav.

people.name: Alice Charlotte von Rothschild
people.note: Unmarried; inherited Waddesdon Manor from her brother Ferdinand in 1898 and left it to her cousin James Armand.

people.name: Laura Thérèse von Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Mayer Carl; married James Édouard in 1871; mother of Henri.

people.name: Hannah Primrose, Countess of Rosebery
people.note: Only child of Mayer Amschel; inheriting Mentmore and his fortune in 1874 made her the richest woman in Britain. Married Archibald Primrose, 5th Earl of Rosebery (later Prime Minister), on 20 March 1878; died of typhoid in 1890.

people.name: Adelheid von Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Wilhelm Carl and Mathilde; married her cousin Edmond in 1877; mother of James Armand and Maurice.

people.name: Minna Caroline von Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Wilhelm Carl von Rothschild; married the banker Maximilian Goldschmidt on 27 February 1878. Their descendants carried the name Goldschmidt-Rothschild.

people.name: Bettina Caroline de Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Alphonse; married Albert Salomon of Vienna in 1876; mother of Louis Nathaniel.

people.name: Etienne van Zuylen van Nyevelt
people.note: Baron who married Helene de Rothschild, daughter of Salomon James de Rothschild, in 1887; father of Egmont van Zuylen van Nyevelt.

people.name: Hélène van Zuylen (née de Rothschild)
people.note: Only child of Salomon James and Adèle; writer. Driving as 'Snail' in the 1898 Paris–Amsterdam–Paris race, she became the first woman to compete in an international motor race. Married the Catholic Baron Étienne van Zuylen in 1887.

people.name: Zoe Lucie Betty de Rothschild
people.note: Eldest daughter of Gustave de Rothschild and Cecile Anspach; married the Brussels banker Baron Leon Lambert in 1882.

people.name: Beatrice Ephrussi de Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Alphonse and Leonora de Rothschild; married the banker Maurice Ephrussi in 1883.

people.name: Aline Caroline de Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Gustave de Rothschild and Cecile Anspach; married Sir Edward Albert Sassoon, 2nd Bt, on 19 October 1887; mother of Philip and Sybil Sassoon.

people.name: Walter Rothschild, 2nd Baron Rothschild
people.note: Zoologist; opened his private museum at Tring in 1892 (now the Natural History Museum at Tring). Addressee of the Balfour Declaration, 2 November 1917. Never married.

people.name: Édouard Alphonse James de Rothschild
people.note: Head of de Rothschild Frères from his father's death in 1905; married Germaine Halphen (1905); father of Guy.

people.name: Bertha Juliette de Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Gustave de Rothschild and Cecile Anspach; married Baron David Emmanuel Leonino in 1892 and died in 1896.

people.name: Rózsika Rothschild (née von Wertheimstein)
people.note: Married Charles on 6 February 1907; mother of Miriam, Victor and Nica.

people.name: Henri de Rothschild
people.note: Physician (MD 1898, never practised) and playwright under the pen name André Pascal; father of Philippe.

people.name: Edgar Spiegl, Edler von Thurnsee
people.note: Husband of Lucy Georgine von Goldschmidt-Rothschild.

people.name: Charles Rothschild
people.note: Nathaniel Charles: banker and entomologist who described about 500 new flea species (collection of some 260,000 fleas); founded the Society for the Promotion of Nature Reserves in 1912.

people.name: Georg Anselm Alphonse von Rothschild
people.note: Eldest child of Albert Salomon and Bettina Caroline; no marriage recorded.

people.name: Alphonse Mayer von Rothschild
people.note: Son of Albert Salomon; married Clarice Adelaide Sebag-Montefiore on 20 November 1912; three children.

people.name: James Armand de Rothschild
people.note: Son of Edmond; Liberal MP for the Isle of Ely 1929–1945. Inherited Waddesdon from Alice and bequeathed it to the National Trust in 1957.

people.name: Albert Maximilian von Goldschmidt-Rothschild
people.note: Eldest son of Maximilian and Minna von Goldschmidt-Rothschild; married Miriam Alexandrine de Rothschild (1884-1965) in 1910.

people.name: Charlotte Esther von Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Albert Salomon and Bettina Caroline; died in childhood.

people.name: Robert de Rothschild
people.note: Robert Philippe Gustave, son of Gustave; married Nelly Beer (1907); father of Alain and Élie.

people.name: Maurice de Rothschild
people.note: Deputy (1919–1929) and senator for Hautes-Alpes (1929–1945); inherited the fortune of his childless great-uncle Adolph Carl and helped establish the family's Swiss branch. Father of Edmond Adolphe.

people.name: Philipp Schey von Koromla
people.note: Baron; married Lili Jeannette von Goldschmidt-Rothschild in 1906.

people.name: Rudolph Maximilian von Goldschmidt-Rothschild
people.note: Second son of Maximilian and Minna von Goldschmidt-Rothschild; married Betty Lambert (1894-1969).

people.name: Lionel Nathan de Rothschild
people.note: Son of Leopold; bought the Exbury estate in 1919 and created Exbury Gardens; father of Edmund.

people.name: Louis Nathaniel de Rothschild
people.note: Last head of the Vienna house; ran the Creditanstalt and the family's Austrian companies from 1911. Arrested by the Nazis after the 1938 Anschluss and released only after lengthy negotiations and a large payment.

people.name: Lili Jeannette von Goldschmidt-Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Maximilian and Minna von Goldschmidt-Rothschild; married Baron Philipp Schey von Koromla in 1906. Their daughter Alix (1911-1982) married Guy de Rothschild in 1937.

people.name: Eugène Daniel von Rothschild
people.note: Son of Albert Salomon; married Kitty (born [private person]) in 1925 and Jeanne Stuart in 1952.

people.name: Miriam Caroline Alexandrine de Rothschild
people.note: Born a Rothschild; married Albert Maximilian von Goldschmidt-Rothschild in 1910. Parentage not recorded here (Paris partition).

people.name: Evelyn Achille de Rothschild
people.note: Banker and soldier; the Wikipedia genealogy says he died in action after the Battle of Mughar Ridge.

people.name: Valentine Noémi von Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Albert Salomon; married Baron [private person].

people.name: Anthony Gustav de Rothschild
people.note: Son of Leopold; married Yvonne Cahen d'Anvers (1926); father of Sir Evelyn.

people.name: Oskar Ruben von Rothschild
people.note: Youngest listed child of Albert Salomon and Bettina Caroline.

people.name: Lucy Georgine von Goldschmidt-Rothschild
people.note: Younger daughter of Maximilian and Minna von Goldschmidt-Rothschild; married Edgar Spiegl, Edler von Thurnsee (1876-1931).

people.name: Betty Lambert
people.note: Wife of Rudolph Maximilian von Goldschmidt-Rothschild.

people.name: Erich von Goldschmidt-Rothschild
people.note: Youngest child of Maximilian and Minna von Goldschmidt-Rothschild; married a Countess Henckel von Donnersmarck (b. 1902) in 1925.

people.name: Yvonne Lydia Louise Cahen d'Anvers
people.note: Married Anthony Gustav de Rothschild in 1926.

people.name: Katharina Henckel von Donnersmarck
people.note: Countess Henckel von Donnersmarck; married Erich von Goldschmidt-Rothschild in 1925.

people.name: Philippe de Rothschild
people.note: Son of Henri; in 1973 Château Mouton Rothschild became the only estate ever promoted to First Growth in the 1855 classification.

people.name: Jeanne Stuart
people.note: Second wife of Eugène Daniel von Rothschild (married 1952). QID taken from a Wikidata search title, not opened.

people.name: Miriam Rothschild
people.note: Zoologist and entomologist, authority on fleas; with G. H. E. Hopkins wrote the six-volume Illustrated Catalogue of the Rothschild Collection of Fleas (1953–81).

people.name: Guy de Rothschild
people.note: Son of Édouard; took formal control of the Paris bank after his father's death in 1949 and modernised it; the bank was nationalised by Mitterrand's government in 1982.

people.name: Victor Rothschild, 3rd Baron Rothschild
people.note: Biologist; in MI5 during the Second World War (explosives and sabotage section; George Medal). Rumours that he was the 'Fifth Man' were rejected: in 1986 the government said it had no evidence he had ever been a Soviet agent, and the…

people.name: Barbara Hutchinson
people.note: Married Victor Rothschild in 1933.

people.name: Pannonica de Koenigswarter (née Rothschild)
people.note: Jazz patron in New York who supported Thelonious Monk and Charlie Parker; married Baron Jules de Koenigswarter (1935).

people.name: George Lane
people.note: Married Miriam Rothschild in 1943.

people.name: Edmund de Rothschild
people.note: Edmund Leopold: chairman of N M Rothschild & Sons 1970–75; restored Exbury Gardens (RHS Victoria Medal of Honour, 2005).

people.name: Élie de Rothschild
people.note: Prisoner of war 1940–44 (including Colditz); ran Château Lafite Rothschild 1946–1974.

people.name: Albert Anselm Salomon Nimrod von Rothschild
people.note: Eldest child of Alphonse Mayer von Rothschild and Clarice Sebag-Montefiore; died 1938.

people.name: Bettina Jemima Looram
people.note: Second child of Alphonse Mayer von Rothschild and Clarice Sebag-Montefiore; married [private person] in 1943.

people.name: Edmond Adolphe de Rothschild
people.note: Son of Maurice; founded La Compagnie Financière Edmond de Rothschild in 1953, the root of today's Edmond de Rothschild Group.

people.name: Gwendoline Charlotte Frances Joan von Rothschild
people.note: Youngest child of Alphonse Mayer von Rothschild and Clarice Sebag-Montefiore.

people.name: Sir Evelyn de Rothschild
people.note: Chairman of N M Rothschild & Sons from 1976 and of The Economist 1972–89.

people.name: Philippine de Rothschild
people.note: Daughter of Philippe and Élisabeth de Chambure, who died at Ravensbrück in 1945.

people.name: Serena Rothschild
people.note: Née Dunn; married Jacob Rothschild in 1961.

people.name: Jacob Rothschild, 4th Baron Rothschild
people.note: Chairman of RIT Capital Partners; chaired the National Gallery trustees 1985–91; inherited Waddesdon in 1988 and led its restoration in partnership with the National Trust.

people.name: Jeannette Bishop
people.note: Married Evelyn Robert de Rothschild in 1966.

people.name: Amschel Rothschild
people.note: Banker; married [private person] in 1981.

people.name: Matilda of Habsburg
people.note: Daughter of Rudolf I; married Louis II, Duke of Bavaria and Count Palatine of the Rhine.

people.name: Albert I of Germany
people.note: Son of Rudolf I; German king and Duke of Austria and Styria.

people.name: Katharina of Habsburg
people.note: Daughter of Rudolf I; married Otto (1261-1312) of the Bavarian house.

people.name: Gertrud of Habsburg
people.note: Daughter of Rudolf I; married Albert II, Duke of Saxe-Wittenberg.

people.name: Heilwig of Habsburg
people.note: Daughter of Rudolf I; married Otto 'the Small', Margrave of Brandenburg-Salzwedel.

people.name: Rudolf I of Bohemia

people.name: Elisabeth of Austria

people.name: Katharina of Austria

people.note: Son of Albert I; married Elisabeth of Virneburg.

people.name: Isabella of Aragon

people.name: Joanna of Pfirt
people.note: Daughter of Count Ulrich II of Pfirt; wife of Albert II, Duke of Austria.

people.name: Otto, Duke of Austria
people.note: Son of Albert I; married Elisabeth of Bavaria (1325) and Anne of Bohemia (1335); his two sons died in 1344.

people.name: Guta of Austria
people.note: Daughter of Albert I; married Count Ludwig VII of Oettingen in 1319.

people.name: Elisabeth of Virneburg
people.note: Daughter of Count Ruprecht II of Virneburg; wife of Henry the Gentle of Austria.

people.name: Elisabeth of Bavaria
people.note: Daughter of Duke Stephen I of Bavaria; first wife of Otto, Duke of Austria (married 1325).

people.name: Anne of Bohemia
people.note: Daughter of King John of Bohemia; second wife of Otto, Duke of Austria (married 1335).

people.name: Rudolf IV, Duke of Austria
people.note: Eldest son of Albert II; Duke of Austria; married Katharina, daughter of Emperor Charles IV.

people.name: Catherine of Bohemia
people.note: Daughter of Emperor Charles IV; wife of Rudolf IV, Duke of Austria.

people.name: Margarete of Austria
people.note: Daughter of Albert II; married Meinhard III, Duke of Upper Bavaria and Count of Tyrol.

people.name: Frederick III, Duke of Austria
people.note: Son of Albert II, Duke of Austria; died unmarried in 1362.

people.name: Albert III, Duke of Austria
people.note: Son of Albert II; Duke of Austria and founder of the Albertine line.

people.name: Viridis Visconti
people.note: Wife of Leopold III, Duke of Austria; the Stammliste gives her death as before 1414.

people.name: Leopold III, Duke of Austria
people.note: Son of Albert II; founder of the Leopoldine line; married Viridis Visconti.

people.name: Beatrix of Nuremberg
people.note: Second wife of Albert III, Duke of Austria (married 1375); mother of Albert IV.

people.name: Margaret of Pomerania
people.note: Daughter of Duke Bogislaw V of Pomerania; first wife of Ernest the Iron; the Stammliste lists no children of this marriage.

people.name: William, Duke of Austria
people.note: Eldest son of Leopold III; married Joanna (later Joanna II of Naples) in 1401.

people.name: Leopold IV, Duke of Austria
people.note: Son of Leopold III; married Catherine of Burgundy.

people.name: Joanna II of Naples
people.note: Daughter of Charles of Durazzo (King of Naples and Hungary); married William of Austria in 1401; later Queen of Naples.

people.name: Joanna Sophia of Bavaria
people.note: Daughter of Albert I, Duke of Bavaria-Straubing; wife of Albert IV, Duke of Austria.

people.name: Albert IV, Duke of Austria
people.note: Only son of Albert III; Duke of Austria; married Joanna Sophia of Bavaria-Straubing.

people.name: Ernest, Duke of Austria
people.note: Son of Leopold III; married Margaret of Pomerania, then Cymburgis of Masovia; father of Emperor Frederick III.

people.name: Catherine of Burgundy
people.note: Daughter of Philip the Bold, Duke of Burgundy; wife of Leopold IV, Duke of Austria.

people.name: Elisabeth of the Palatinate
people.note: Daughter of King Rupert of Germany; first wife of Frederick IV, Duke of Austria.

people.name: Frederick IV, Duke of Austria
people.note: Son of Leopold III; ruled Tyrol; married Elisabeth of the Palatinate, then Anna of Brunswick.

people.name: Anna of Brunswick
people.note: Daughter of Frederick I, Duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg; second wife of Frederick IV and mother of Sigismund.

people.name: Cymburgis of Masovia
people.note: Second wife of Ernest the Iron and mother of Emperor Frederick III.

people.name: Margarete of Austria
people.note: Daughter of Albert IV; married Henry XVI the Rich, Duke of Bavaria-Landshut, in 1412.

people.name: Albert II of Germany
people.note: Son of Albert IV; as Duke of Austria Albert V and as German king Albert II; married Elisabeth of Luxembourg.

people.name: Elisabeth of Luxembourg
people.note: Daughter of Emperor Sigismund; wife of Albert II of Germany.

people.name: Frederick III, Holy Roman Emperor
people.note: Son of Ernest the Iron; Holy Roman Emperor; married Eleanor of Portugal.

people.name: Margarete of Austria
people.note: Daughter of Ernest the Iron; married Frederick II, Elector of Saxony.

people.name: Albert VI, Archduke of Austria
people.note: Son of Ernest the Iron and younger brother of Emperor Frederick III.

people.name: Katharina of Austria
people.note: Daughter of Ernest the Iron; married Charles I, Margrave of Baden.

people.name: Sigismund, Archduke of Austria
people.note: Son of Frederick IV; ruled Tyrol; married Eleanor of Scotland (1449) and Catherine of Saxony (1484), both childless.

people.name: Eleanor of Scotland
people.note: Daughter of King James I of Scotland; first wife of Sigismund of Austria (married 1449); no children.

people.name: Anna of Austria
people.note: Daughter of Albert II of Germany; married Duke William III of Saxony in 1446.

people.name: Eleanor of Portugal
people.note: Portuguese infanta; wife of Emperor Frederick III and mother of Maximilian I.

people.name: Elisabeth of Austria
people.note: Daughter of Albert II of Germany; married King Casimir IV of Poland in 1454.

people.name: Ladislaus the Posthumous
people.note: Posthumous son of Albert II of Germany; with his death in 1457 the Albertine line ended.

people.name: Mary of Burgundy
people.note: Duchess of Burgundy, daughter of Charles the Bold; died after a riding accident near Wijnendale.

people.name: Maximilian I, Holy Roman Emperor
people.note: Son of Frederick III; his marriage to Mary of Burgundy (19 August 1477) brought the Burgundian inheritance, and their son's marriage to Joanna of Castile brought Spain.

people.name: Kunigunde of Austria
people.note: Daughter of Frederick III; married Albert IV, Duke of Bavaria.

people.name: Catherine of Saxony
people.note: Daughter of Albert the Brave, Duke of Saxony; second wife of Sigismund of Austria (married 1484); no children.

people.name: Bianca Maria Sforza
people.note: Daughter of Duke Galeazzo Maria Sforza of Milan; third wife of Maximilian I; the Stammliste lists no children of the marriage.

people.name: Philip I of Castile ('the Handsome')
people.note: Married Joanna of Castile on 20 October 1496; founder of the Spanish Habsburg line, with an inbreeding coefficient of only 0.025 (Alvarez et al. 2009).

people.name: Joanna of Castile
people.note: Daughter of Ferdinand II of Aragon and Isabella I of Castile; confined at Tordesillas for most of her life. Her epithet 'the Mad' is disputed by historians.

people.name: Margaret of Austria, Duchess of Savoy
people.note: Daughter of Maximilian I and Mary of Burgundy; married John of Asturias, then Philibert II of Savoy.

people.name: Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor
people.note: Holy Roman Emperor and King of Spain; married his first cousin Isabella of Portugal in 1526.

people.name: Anna of Bohemia and Hungary
people.note: Jagiellonian princess; wife of Ferdinand I.

people.name: Ferdinand I, Holy Roman Emperor
people.note: Younger brother of Charles V and founder of the Austrian line; married Anna of Bohemia and Hungary on 26 May 1521.

people.name: Isabella of Portugal
people.note: Daughter of Manuel I of Portugal and Maria of Aragon (Joanna's sister), and therefore Charles V's first cousin.

people.name: Maximilian II, Holy Roman Emperor
people.note: Father of Anna, Queen of Spain, and of Rudolf II.

people.name: Philip II of Spain
people.note: Married four times; his fourth wife, Anna of Austria (1570), was his niece, the daughter of his sister Maria.

people.name: Anna of Austria, Duchess of Bavaria
people.note: Daughter of Ferdinand I; wife of Albert V of Bavaria and mother of Maria Anna of Bavaria (born 1551).

people.name: Maria of Austria, Holy Roman Empress
people.note: Married her first cousin Maximilian II on 15 September 1548.

people.name: Charles II, Archduke of Inner Austria
people.note: Ruler of Inner Austria from Graz; married his niece Maria Anna of Bavaria on 26 August 1571.

people.name: Anna of Austria, Queen of Spain
people.note: Fourth wife of her uncle Philip II (1570); mother of Philip III.

people.name: Maria Anna of Bavaria (1551–1608)
people.note: Daughter of Albert V of Bavaria and Anna of Austria; married her maternal uncle Charles II in 1571; mother of Ferdinand II and of Margaret, Queen of Spain.

people.name: Ferdinand II, Holy Roman Emperor
people.note: Holy Roman Emperor from 1619. His first wife (1600), Maria Anna of Bavaria (1574–1616), was his cousin and the mother of Ferdinand III; she is not modelled here.

people.name: Philip III of Spain
people.note: Married his Habsburg cousin Margaret of Austria on 18 April 1599.

people.name: Margaret of Austria, Queen of Spain
people.note: Sister of Ferdinand II; married Philip III in 1599. She is both paternal grandmother and maternal great-grandmother of Charles II of Spain.

people.name: Philip IV of Spain
people.note: His second wife, Mariana of Austria (7 October 1649), was his niece; father of Margaret Theresa and Charles II.

people.name: Maria Anna of Spain
people.note: Married her first cousin Ferdinand III in 1631; mother of Mariana and Leopold I.

people.name: Ferdinand III, Holy Roman Emperor
people.note: Son of Ferdinand II and Maria Anna of Bavaria (1574–1616); married his first cousin Maria Anna of Spain in 1631.

people.name: Mariana of Austria
people.note: Married her maternal uncle Philip IV in 1649; mother of Charles II.

people.name: Leopold I, Holy Roman Emperor
people.note: His first wife Margaret Theresa of Spain (12 December 1666) was 'both his niece and his first cousin'. Charles VI was his son by his third wife, Eleonore Magdalene of Neuburg.

people.name: Margaret Theresa of Spain
people.note: Married her uncle and first cousin Leopold I in 1666.

people.name: Charles II of Spain
people.note: Last Spanish Habsburg; childless. Son of an uncle–niece marriage; his inbreeding coefficient F = 0.254 (Alvarez, Ceballos & Quinteiro 2009) is close to that of a parent–child or brother–sister union (0.25).

people.name: Charles VI, Holy Roman Emperor
people.note: Son of Leopold I by Eleonore Magdalene of Neuburg; the only surviving male Habsburg of his generation; father of Maria Theresa.

people.name: Francis I, Holy Roman Emperor
people.note: Francis Stephen, Duke of Lorraine; his paternal grandmother Eleonore was a daughter of Ferdinand III, so Wikipedia calls him Maria Theresa's second cousin.

people.name: Maria Theresa
people.note: The only woman to hold the Habsburg dominions in her own right; married Francis Stephen of Lorraine on 12 February 1736.

people.name: Joseph II, Holy Roman Emperor
people.note: Succeeded his father as Holy Roman Emperor in 1765; left no surviving children.

people.name: Leopold II, Holy Roman Emperor
people.note: Grand Duke of Tuscany, then emperor (1790); married Maria Luisa of Spain; father of Francis II.

people.name: Maria Carolina of Austria
people.note: Daughter of Maria Theresa and sister of Marie Antoinette; Queen of Naples and Sicily as wife of Ferdinand I of the Two Sicilies; mother of Empress Maria Theresa of Naples.

people.name: Marie Antoinette
people.note: Daughter of Maria Theresa; married Louis, Dauphin of France (proxy wedding in Vienna, April 1770), later Louis XVI; Queen of France.

people.name: Francis II, Holy Roman Emperor
people.note: Emperor of Austria from 1804 and the last Holy Roman Emperor (abdicated 1806). His second wife, Maria Theresa of Naples, was his double first cousin; his third, Maria Ludovika of Austria-Este, his first cousin.

people.name: Maria Theresa of Naples and Sicily
people.note: Daughter of Ferdinand I of the Two Sicilies and Maria Carolina of Austria (a daughter of Maria Theresa); married her double first cousin Francis on 15 September 1790; mother of Franz Karl.

people.name: Archduke Franz Karl of Austria
people.note: Married Princess Sophie of Bavaria; father of Franz Joseph I and Maximilian I of Mexico.

people.name: Franz Joseph I of Austria
people.note: Married his first cousin Elisabeth on 24 April 1854; his mother Sophie and her mother Ludovika were sisters.

people.name: Empress Elisabeth of Austria ('Sisi')
people.note: Daughter of Duke Maximilian Joseph in Bavaria and Princess Ludovika; assassinated in Geneva on 10 September 1898.

people.name: Rudolf, Crown Prince of Austria
people.note: Only son of Franz Joseph and Elisabeth; died at Mayerling (murder–suicide).

houses.name: Erasmus Darwin's household
houses.note: Erasmus Darwin's household; the Parker and Galton sub-lines are kept inside it (seat: Lichfield)

houses.name: Etruria / Maer
houses.note: Josiah Wedgwood's Etruria and Josiah II's Maer Hall, one household thread (seat: Etruria Hall, Stoke-on-Trent)

houses.name: Shrewsbury (The Mount)
houses.note: Robert Waring Darwin's household (seat: Shrewsbury)

houses.name: Down House
houses.note: Charles and Emma Darwin's household (seat: Downe, Kent)

houses.name: Cambridge
houses.note: the households of Charles's sons in Cambridge (seat: Cambridge)

houses.name: Leith Hill Place
houses.note: Josiah III and Caroline Darwin's household (seat: Leith Hill Place, Surrey)

houses.name: Barlaston
houses.note: Francis Wedgwood's line (seat: Barlaston, Staffordshire)

houses.name: Hensleigh Wedgwood's household
houses.note: Hensleigh and Fanny Wedgwood in London (seat: London)

people.name: Josiah Wedgwood
people.note: Potter, entrepreneur and abolitionist; founded the Wedgwood company in 1759. Married his cousin Sarah Wedgwood on 25 January 1764 ('third cousin' per the Darwin–Wedgwood family article; 'distant cousin' per his own).

people.name: Erasmus Darwin
people.note: Grandfather of both Charles Darwin (through Robert, son of his first wife Mary Howard) and Francis Galton (through Violetta, daughter of his second wife Elizabeth Pole).

people.name: Sarah Wedgwood
people.note: Wife and cousin of Josiah Wedgwood; mother of Susannah, John, Josiah II and Thomas.

people.name: Mary Howard
people.note: First wife of Erasmus Darwin (m. 1757); mother of Robert Waring Darwin; died aged 30.

people.name: Charles Darwin
people.note: Eldest son of Erasmus Darwin; uncle and namesake of the naturalist.

people.name: Erasmus Darwin
people.note: Second son of Erasmus Darwin and Mary Howard.

people.name: Elizabeth Darwin
people.note: Daughter of Erasmus Darwin and Mary Howard; the family article gives only the year 1763.

people.name: Elizabeth 'Bessy' Allen
people.note: Daughter of John Bartlett Allen (1733–1803) of Cresselly; her sisters married John Wedgwood (Louisa Jane) and Sir James Mackintosh (Catherine), which made several Wedgwood marriages double-cousin unions.

people.name: Susannah Darwin (née Wedgwood)
people.note: Eldest child of Josiah Wedgwood; wife of Robert Darwin and mother of Charles Darwin.

people.name: John Wedgwood
people.note: A founder of the (Royal) Horticultural Society: proposed it in 1801 and chaired its first meeting on 7 March 1804. Married Louisa Jane Allen (1794), younger sister of his brother Josiah II's wife.

people.name: Robert Darwin
people.note: Robert Waring Darwin, son of Erasmus; married Josiah Wedgwood's daughter Susannah, the first Darwin–Wedgwood marriage; father of Charles.

people.name: Richard Wedgwood
people.note: Son of Josiah and Sarah Wedgwood; died in infancy.

people.name: William Alvey Darwin
people.note: Son of Erasmus Darwin and Mary Howard; the family article gives only the year 1767.

people.name: Josiah Wedgwood II
people.note: Son of Josiah; father of nine, including Josiah III, Henry Allen, Hensleigh and Emma Darwin.

people.name: Thomas Wedgwood
people.note: Pioneer of photography; friend and patron of Samuel Taylor Coleridge.

people.name: Susanna Parker
people.note: Daughter of Erasmus Darwin and Miss Parker, born between his two marriages.

people.name: Catherine Wedgwood
people.note: Daughter of Josiah and Sarah Wedgwood; had no children.

people.name: Mary Parker
people.note: Daughter of Erasmus Darwin and Miss Parker, born between his two marriages.

people.name: Sarah Wedgwood
people.note: Youngest surviving daughter of Josiah and Sarah Wedgwood; had no children.

people.name: Mary Anne Wedgwood
people.note: Youngest child of Josiah and Sarah Wedgwood; died in childhood.

people.name: Edward Darwin
people.note: Eldest son of Erasmus Darwin and Elizabeth Pole.

people.name: Frances Anne Violetta Darwin
people.note: Daughter of Erasmus by his second wife Elizabeth Pole; married Samuel Tertius Galton (1783–1844); mother of Francis Galton.

people.name: Samuel Tertius Galton
people.note: Husband of Violetta Darwin; father of Francis Galton.

people.name: Emma Georgina Elizabeth Darwin
people.note: Daughter of Erasmus Darwin and Elizabeth Pole.

people.name: Francis Sacheverel Darwin
people.note: Son of Erasmus Darwin and Elizabeth Pole; married Jane Harriet Ryle.

people.name: John Darwin
people.note: Clergyman; son of Erasmus Darwin and Elizabeth Pole.

people.name: Henry Parker
people.note: Husband of Marianne Darwin, the eldest sister of Charles Darwin.

people.name: Henry Darwin
people.note: Son of Erasmus Darwin and Elizabeth Pole.

people.name: Harriet Darwin
people.note: Youngest child of Erasmus Darwin and Elizabeth Pole; later Mrs Maling.

people.name: Sarah Elizabeth Wedgwood
people.note: Eldest child of Josiah Wedgwood II and Elizabeth Allen.

people.name: Josiah Wedgwood III
people.note: Emma's elder brother; married his first cousin Caroline Darwin.

people.name: Mary Ann Wedgwood
people.note: Daughter of Josiah Wedgwood II and Elizabeth Allen; died in infancy.

people.name: Charlotte Wedgwood
people.note: Daughter of Josiah Wedgwood II; first wife of Charles Langton, who after her death married her cousin Emily Catherine Darwin.

people.name: Marianne Darwin
people.note: Eldest child of Robert Waring Darwin; married Henry Parker.

people.name: Henry Allen Wedgwood
people.note: Married his double first cousin Jessie Wedgwood on 14 September 1830 at Abergavenny: their fathers were brothers and their mothers were sisters.

people.name: Caroline Sarah Darwin
people.note: Charles's elder sister; married her first cousin Josiah Wedgwood III; grandmother of Ralph Vaughan Williams.

people.name: Frances 'Fanny' Mackintosh
people.note: Second child of Sir James Mackintosh and his second wife Catherine Allen; married her cousin Hensleigh Wedgwood in 1832; mother of the writer Julia Wedgwood.

people.name: Francis Wedgwood
people.note: Partner in the Wedgwood firm from 1827, later in sole charge, retiring in 1876; built a house at Barlaston. Married Frances Mosley at Rolleston on Dove on 26 April 1832.

people.name: Hensleigh Wedgwood
people.note: Etymologist (A Dictionary of English Etymology, 1857) and founding member of the Philological Society. Married his first cousin Fanny Mackintosh in 1832: her mother Catherine Allen was his mother's sister.

people.name: Susan Elizabeth Darwin
people.note: Daughter of Robert Waring Darwin and Susannah Wedgwood.

people.name: Erasmus Alvey Darwin
people.note: Charles's elder brother.

people.name: Jessie Wedgwood
people.note: Daughter of John Wedgwood and Louisa Jane Allen; married her double first cousin Henry Allen Wedgwood (1830); six children.

people.name: Frances Wedgwood
people.note: Daughter of Josiah Wedgwood II and Elizabeth Allen; died unmarried in 1832.

people.name: Emma Darwin (née Wedgwood)
people.note: Youngest child of Josiah II; married her first cousin Charles Darwin; mother of ten children, three of whom died young.

people.name: Charles Darwin
people.note: Naturalist; married his first cousin Emma Wedgwood. Because his mother and Emma's father were siblings, their children had six great-grandparents instead of eight.

people.name: Emily Catherine Darwin
people.note: Youngest child of Robert Waring Darwin; second wife of Charles Langton.

people.name: Francis Galton
people.note: Grandson of Erasmus Darwin and so Charles Darwin's half-first cousin (same grandfather, different grandmothers). Married Louisa Jane Butler (1853); childless.

people.name: Godfrey Wedgwood
people.note: Eldest child of Francis Wedgwood and Frances Mosley.

people.name: Amy Wedgwood
people.note: Daughter of Francis Wedgwood and Frances Mosley.

people.name: Cicely Mary Wedgwood
people.note: Daughter of Francis Wedgwood and Frances Mosley.

people.name: Sara Sedgwick
people.note: Wife of William Erasmus Darwin.

people.name: William Erasmus Darwin
people.note: Eldest child of Charles and Emma; married Sara Sedgwick; no children.

people.name: Clement Wedgwood
people.note: Son of Francis Wedgwood and Frances Mosley; partner in the Wedgwood pottery firm and father of Sir Ralph Wedgwood, 1st Baronet.

people.name: Anne Elizabeth 'Annie' Darwin
people.note: Died aged ten.

people.name: Mary Eleanor Darwin
people.note: Third child of Charles and Emma Darwin; died in infancy.

people.name: Henrietta Litchfield (née Darwin)
people.note: 'Etty'; married Richard Litchfield in 1871; no children. Editor of Emma Darwin: A Century of Family Letters.

people.name: Margaret Susan Vaughan Williams (née Wedgwood)
people.note: Daughter of Josiah III and Caroline Darwin (inferred: Wikipedia names them as Ralph Vaughan Williams's maternal grandparents); wife of the Rev. Arthur Vaughan Williams and mother of the composer.

people.name: Laurence Wedgwood
people.note: Son of Francis Wedgwood and Frances Mosley.

people.name: George Darwin
people.note: Sir George Howard Darwin; married Maud du Puy (1861–1947); father of Gwen Raverat and Charles Galton Darwin.

people.name: Constance Rose Wedgwood
people.note: Daughter of Francis Wedgwood and Frances Mosley.

people.name: Elizabeth Darwin
people.note: Daughter of Charles Darwin; never married.

people.name: Francis Darwin
people.note: Married Amy Ruck (1874), Ellen Crofts (1883) and [private person] (1913).

people.name: Leonard Darwin
people.note: Son of Charles and Emma; the last of their children to die.

people.name: Horace Darwin
people.note: Youngest surviving son; married Ida Farrer (1854–1946).

people.name: Mabel Frances Wedgwood
people.note: Youngest child of Francis Wedgwood and Frances Mosley; born and died in 1852.

people.name: Ida Farrer
people.note: Wife of Horace Darwin; mother of Nora Barlow and [private person].

people.name: Charles Waring Darwin
people.note: Youngest child of Charles and Emma Darwin; died in infancy.

people.name: Ralph Vaughan Williams
people.note: Composer; grandson of Josiah Wedgwood III and Caroline Darwin, so great-nephew of both Charles and Emma Darwin.

people.name: Sir Ralph Wedgwood, 1st Baronet
people.note: Railway executive, created a baronet; son of Clement Wedgwood.

people.name: Bernard Darwin
people.note: Son of Francis Darwin and Amy Ruck; married Elinor Monsell.

people.name: Gwen Raverat (née Darwin)
people.note: Wood engraver and author of the memoir Period Piece (1952) about her Cambridge childhood; granddaughter of Charles Darwin. Parentage not fetched directly (WebFetch budget ran out).

people.name: Nora Barlow
people.note: Daughter of Horace Darwin; married [private person].

people.name: Frances Cornford
people.note: Daughter of Francis Darwin and Ellen Crofts; married Francis Cornford.

people.name: Charles Galton Darwin
people.note: Son of George Darwin and Maud du Puy.

people.name: Margaret Darwin
people.note: Daughter of George Darwin; married the surgeon [private person].

people.name: William Robert Darwin
people.note: Son of George Darwin and Maud du Puy; married Sarah Monica Slingsby.
